_comment: Three rules, nothing else. Run by `npm test` (see test/css-lint.mjs).
1. No raw cubic-bezier() outside tokens.css: every curve is a named --ease-* token.
2. font-family names one of the four semantic tokens (--font-editorial, --font-structural,
--font-meta, --font-data), or Paper's --np-font-* aliases of them, or inherit.
3. border-radius is 0, 50%, inherit or a var(). A literal radius that predates the scale carries a
stylelint-disable-next-line comment on the line above it; reportNeedlessDisables makes
that comment an error once the literal is gone, so the list only shrinks.
games.css and revolt.css are hidden routes and are exempt from all three, as in the class
parity gate. tokens.css defines the curves and the font stacks, so it is exempt from 1 and 2.
ig-render.css is exempt from 2 by decision (the Instagram renderer).
